tools.name: resolve_artist
tools.description:
Map a name, URL or id to hosaka's verified artist identity (`cluster_id`) with an ambiguity verdict.
Use: the user names an artist; you hold a Discogs / MusicBrainz / Bandcamp URL or id.
Inputs: one of `q`, `url`, `cluster_id`, `discogs_id`, `mbid`.
Returns: `cluster_id`, `display`, `slug`, `resolve

Inputs: `key`: cluster_id from resolve_artist, or slug; `limit` 1–2

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description:
The linked account's stable, opaque profile id (and display name if set); never ask the user for it.
Use: the host needs a stable user handle; after sign-in to confirm the link.
Inputs: none.
Returns: `data.id`, `data.name`, `data.account_mode`, `data.linked_since`.
Auth: linked.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description:
The linked account's current-period usage against its temporary allowance, with the 80 % warning and reset time.
Use: the user asks how much is left; after quota_exceeded or a quota warning.
Inputs: `period`: only "current" in v1.
Returns: `allowance`, `used`, `warning_80`, `reset_at`, `account_mode
